# ui::testing::TestNativeHost

Header: `winui/testing/TestNativeHost.hpp`.

Derives from `ui::NativeHost`.

[NativeHost](../rendering/native-host.md) test double: tracks one [Entry](#struct-entry) per native child instead of creating native windows.

A [NativeControl](../controls/native-control.md#uinativecontrol)'s lifecycle (create once, move on every changed arrange, hide/show, clip, destroy with the control) is plain state, and this host records it so a test can check it without a window. Hand it to [Element::sync_native()](../tree/element.md#sync_native) or install it with Window::set_native_host(). The host must outlive every control synced against it, since a [NativeControl](../controls/native-control.md#uinativecontrol) calls [destroy()](#destroy) from its destructor.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::NativeControlDesc desc;
desc.class_name = "EDIT";

ui::testing::TestNativeHost host;
{
    ui::NativeControl control{desc, ui::Size{120.0f, 24.0f}};
    control.arrange({10, 10, 120, 24});
    control.sync_native(host);

    const ui::testing::TestNativeHost::Entry* entry = host.find(control.visual_id());
    REQUIRE(entry != nullptr);
    REQUIRE(entry->create_count == 1);
    REQUIRE(entry->bounds == ui::Rect{10, 10, 120, 24});
    REQUIRE(entry->owner == &control);
}
REQUIRE(host.count() == 0); // destroyed along with the control
```

## ensure_created

```cpp
void ensure_created(VisualId id, const NativeControlDesc& desc) override
```

Creates the entry on the first call for `id` and stores `desc`; later calls are no-ops.

## set_bounds

```cpp
void set_bounds(VisualId id, const Rect& bounds) override
```

Records `bounds` and bumps [Entry::move_count](#struct-entry).

## set_visible

```cpp
void set_visible(VisualId id, bool visible) override
```

Records `visible` and bumps [Entry::visible_count](#struct-entry); ignored for an id with no entry.

## set_clip

```cpp
void set_clip(VisualId id, const std::optional<Rect>& visible) override
```

Records the visible region (nullopt: unclipped) and bumps [Entry::clip_count](#struct-entry).

## destroy

```cpp
void destroy(VisualId id) override
```

Erases the entry, so [find()](#find) returns null and [count()](#count) drops.

## ~TestNativeHost

```cpp
~TestNativeHost() override
```

Tells every control still registered that its host is gone, as the real host does when its window is closed under a tree that lives on.

## set_owner

```cpp
void set_owner(VisualId id, NativeControl* owner) override
```

Records `owner` on the entry for `id`.

## native_handle

```cpp
NativeHandle native_handle(VisualId) const override
```

Always null: no real handle exists headlessly.

## find

```cpp
const Entry* find(VisualId id) const
```

The entry for `id`, or null if it was never touched or has been destroyed. The pointer is invalidated by the next call that adds or erases an entry.

## count

```cpp
std::size_t count() const
```

Number of live entries (native children created or touched and not yet destroyed).

## struct Entry

Everything recorded about one native child, keyed by its [VisualId](../core/namespace-ui.md#visualid).

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `desc` | `NativeControlDesc` |  | The description passed to the first, creating [ensure_created()](#ensure_created) call. |
| `bounds` | `Rect` |  | Last bounds from [set_bounds()](#set_bounds), in window DIPs. |
| `visible` | `bool` | `true` | Last value from [set_visible()](#set_visible); a fresh entry starts visible. |
| `created` | `bool` | `false` | True once [ensure_created()](#ensure_created) has run for this id. |
| `create_count` | `int` | `0` | How many times [ensure_created()](#ensure_created) created the entry; repeat calls don't count. |
| `move_count` | `int` | `0` | Number of [set_bounds()](#set_bounds) calls; a [NativeControl](../controls/native-control.md#uinativecontrol) only moves when its bounds changed. |
| `owner` | `NativeControl*` | `nullptr` | [Control](../tree/spec-vocabulary.md#class-control) registered via [set_owner()](#set_owner), which a real host uses to route the native child's events. |
| `clip` | `std::optional<Rect>` |  | [set_clip()](#set_clip)'s last visible region (nullopt: unclipped). |
| `clip_count` | `int` | `0` | Number of [set_clip()](#set_clip) calls. |
| `visible_count` | `int` | `0` | Number of [set_visible()](#set_visible) calls. |
